technique_name: Come up with a way to celebrate someone's birthday during social distancing.
description: One way to celebrate someone's birthday during social distancing is to have a virtual birthday party! You can use one of the many video conferencing apps to have a virtual gathering with friends, family, and colleagues. You can have everyone bring a few ingredients and contribute to making a cake or special dish while they tell stories and share memories of their friendship.
